name: How to Convert PDF to PowerPoint
description: Turn each page of a PDF into a slide in a real .pptx file — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Choose an output mode and slide quality
step.text: Pick Image (default) or Editable text (beta), then Compact, Balanced, or High quality depending on your needs.

step.name: Download the .pptx file
step.text: Click 'Convert to PowerPoint'. Every page becomes one slide in the original order.
